parts.text: $FIS Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $3.5B, +27% Y/Y, driven by strong client demand and the Total Issuing Solutions acquisition. Operating margin 19.1%; operating cash flow $1.0B. #earnings #industrials
$W Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $3.4B, +10% Y/Y, driven by double-digit U.S. order growth and higher active customers. Operating margin was 3.1%. #earnings #ecommerce
$IEP Q3 2026: revenue $3.2B, +16% Y/Y, as total costs grew faster than sales resulting in an operating margin of -3.6%. The period included the completion of the Pep Boys divestiture. #earnings #oil
$PARR Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $3.1B, +52% Y/Y, driven by strong refining margins and small refinery exemptions. Operating margin 15.5%; net earnings $355M. #earnings #oil
$EXPE Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $4.9B, +12% Y/Y, driven by B2B growth and resilient travel demand. Operating margin 26.9%. #earnings #industrials
$WLK Q3 2026: revenue $3.0B, +5% Y/Y, with an operating margin of 1.4% as restructuring costs weighed on profit following plans to close a German PVC plant. #earnings #materials

$ANDE Q3 2026: Revenue $2.8B, up 6% Y/Y, driven by strong performance in the Renewables segment and clean fuel production credits. Net earnings totaled $46M as Agribusiness merchandising improved. #earnings #industrials
$CWK Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $2.8B, +8% Y/Y, driven by growth in leasing and capital markets. Operating margin was 4.6% as services and project management expanded. #earnings #realestate

$MCK Q2 FY27 (preliminary): revenue $111.0B, +8% Y/Y, driven by growth in North American Pharmaceutical and Oncology & Multispecialty. Operating margin 1.4%; operating cash flow $3.1B. Guides FY27 adjusted EPS to $45.60–$46.40. #earnings #healthcare
$MET Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $20.5B, +18% Y/Y, driven by higher variable investment income and broad-based volume growth. Operating margin 11.8%; net earnings $2.4B. #earnings #insurance
$MRK Q3 2026: revenue $18.1B, +5% Y/Y, driven by oncology and cardiometabolic growth. Operating margin 30.7%; operating cash flow $6.6B. #earnings #pharma

$ALL Q3 2026: revenue $17.3B, +0% Y/Y, driven by higher auto and homeowners policies and investment income, offset by catastrophe losses. Operating margin 15.1%; operating cash flow $3.8B. #earnings #insurance
